# Two pages resolving to the same output path must error out.

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out site.sngl
stderr 'html: page "b" is written to dup.html, as page "a" is'

-- site.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"

output { none { html } }

component main root {
    window(title=pages.current.title) {
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page #a(href="/dup.html", title="A") { text(value="a") }
            nav.page #b(href="/dup.html", title="B") { text(value="b") }
        }
    }
}

main()
